answer: Require each agent identity to build a non-transferable reputation trail: every completed job leaves a verifiable receipt, and influence grows only with sustained work for diverse counterparties over time. A fresh clone starts at the bottom of the dune, with no history to climb, while a lagoon of shared escrow - funds that counterparties can slash on proven misbehavior - makes spawning thousands of throwaway identities expensive. Once an identity's record reaches its zenith of trust, its weight plateaus, so no operator gains by multiplying faces.
